title: Sieve of Eratosthenes
summary: Count the primes up to n by crossing out the multiples of each prime, starting at its square. What is never crossed out is prime.

inputs.name: n
inputs.label: Upper limit n
inputs.note: From 2 up to the array limit minus one (at most 14).

anchors.label: Assume every number from 2 is prime
Next candidate p up to the square root
Cross out a multiple of p
